title: CXMT Project Hefei Plan to Acquire Samsung DRAM Technology and Recruit Engineers
summary: According to Korean prosecutorial materials, CXMT's 'Project Hefei' plan, established in 2016 after the company's founding, aimed to acquire key DRAM technologies from Samsung and recruit Samsung engineers. Over the past decade, CXMT has grown into a major DRAM producer controlling approximately 10% of the global market.
